name: Takahara Toshiro
source:
"I'll do it. I'm going to surpass myself again with this."

He has parkour skills befitting a person who rides and crosses the terrain of the city freely. To him, high walls and obstacles are useless.

However, he also has a painful past. He fell while playing parkour in middle school and injured his leg, which stopped his growth plate, so he is considerably shorter than other boys his age (he is the shortest character in this work.)

He is usually righteous and actively seeks to do things that others are reluctant to do, but he gets offended to the point of spitting out vicious words whenever his height is mentioned.

The reason why he deliberately dresses badly is because he doesn't want to look easy on himself because he is short.
